annotations.title: List asks waiting for my gym

description: Use this when an owner asks who wants to book or visit their place, for example "who asked to book this week?". At a place not on the gym plan, class bookings and 1:1 requests are held for 7 days. It returns each one waiting: its hold_id, the place, the class and its local time (or that it is a 1:1 request), the member's first name, their note and best times, when it expires, and whether it can be accepted now. It reads only and changes nothing. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the place.

place_id.description: Only this place. Leave out for all of the owner's places.

name: list_held_requests

held.description: hold_id, place_id, place_name, kind (class or session), class (title, starts), first_name, note, times, asked_at, expires_at, can_accept and plan_url (the plan on phor.me, a price-free link, when it cannot be accepted yet).
